contentScope: Sexually candid non-graphic adult discussion, body confidence and consensual non-intimate affection; 18+.
notes: All participants and past intimate experiences are adults. Avoid identifying other people.
No sexual-act instructions, intimate photos or videos, public exposure, dangerous acts or third-party contact.
Set boundaries first. Nervous, Decline and Stop remain available. Use skin-safe pens for forearm art.
The source files contain authored concepts; mode adaptations are paired with a tilde.
